_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw an Player {player_id}, naglalara hin {num_rounds} rounds han Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Mayda ka hin ${pool} nga ibabahin para han rundang ini tungod han imo ngan han Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Buhaton hin offer: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Kon gindawat → Ikaw makakakuha hin $(pool - X), an iba nga player makakakuha hin $X
  - Kon gindamdam → An duha makakakuha hin $0
  - Halimbawa: [Offer: $3]  o  'Nakikita ko ini nga patas. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Magdesisyon han offer pinaagi han [Accept] o [Reject]
  - Halimbawa: 'Nagpapakita ini nga makatarungan. [Accept]'
            'Barato kaau. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Rundang {round_number} nagsasanga! ---
Player {proposer_id} an nagproposar, Player {responder_id} an nagresponder.
round.offer: Rundang {round_number}: Igin-offer han Player {proposer_id} hin ${offer} kan Player {responder_id} (nagpapabilin hin ${keep}).
round.accepted: Gindawat han Player {responder_id}! Rundang {round_number} nga benepisyo: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Bag-o nga mga totales: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} rejected the offer! Round {round_number} gains: Both players +$0. Totals remain: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: An nagpropose kinahanglan maghimo hin offer gamit an format [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: An kantidad han bid in kinahanglan magin balido nga integer.
invalid_move.out_of_range: An bid kinahanglan mag-abot ha butnga han $0 ngan ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Waray yana nga igintatanyag nga angay batonon.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: An responder kinahanglan mag-[Accept] o [Reject] han offer.

outcome.win: Nadaog han Player {winner} nga may ${winner_total} nga total kontra han ${loser_total} ni Player {loser}.
outcome.draw: An duha nga magdudula nahuman hin ${total} total.
